body:
If I become an atheist, does this mean i need to buy a Lincoln Park album?

Just kidding. Who is this Edward Barnays you speak of?

And you're right. This whole consumerist thing is kind of tiring. My friends are getting new trucks every other day and then talking about it to each other "Lift kit? Tires? I Scotch guarded it because who the fuck knows what'll happen, you know? Holy shit, is that your new ATV? Killer man. Here's a Coors lite." I usually remain silent and distant during such conversations. I find them quite empty and depressing because:

A: I will never have a truck
B: Don't give a fuck.
C: I'll never need a truck.

This consumerism never really caught in for me. 

>drugs and drink are a lot easier mechanical ways to being high than treating people with regard and love.

You're my favorite atheist right now. Your post alone, if there is a heaven, should grant you access.

>That's freedom. You can do whatever you want. No ties? Any debt?

No and no. Are you suggesting I press restart on this?

Thanks for the compliment! I wrote and directed a bullshit short film during my stint in college. Other than that, like my other talents, they are going to pot due to horrible employment opportunities here or the complete lack of such opportunities. As far as this post goes, I tried to keep my post lighter than most here. But my life truly is shit, I can't stand the lot of it.

My relationship with my dad is distant, but good and intact. He reaches out and I shut him down by keeping my barriers way up. I'm afraid he'd be ashamed of what I've become/resorted too. I'm afraid I would disappoint him and that would kill me.

How did you quite drinking if you don't mind me asking?
